issues.description: The screen is stuck on the room type selection UI (Step 1 of 4) and never transitions to show the 2x2 style image grid for anchor question 1 of 3 after a room is selected. The expected behavior says this is step-2 which should show room selection AND then transition to style images after selection. The progress indicator reads 'STEP 1 OF 4' but we are on the /design/step-2 route.
issues.element: Room selection / style image grid transition
issues.root_cause: The page component at apps/web/app/design/step-2/page.tsx likely has a state management issue where selecting a room type does not trigger the transition to the style anchor question UI. Either the onClick handler is missing/broken, the state update doesn't cause a re-render to the next view, or the conditional rendering for the style image grid phase is broken.

issues.description: Progress indicator shows 'STEP 1 OF 4' but the current route is /design/step-2. If step-2 is meant to be the second step in the flow, the indicator should likely show 'STEP 2 OF 4' or the step count labeling is intentionally starting at step-1 for the first anchor question within step-2.
issues.root_cause: The step counter variable in apps/web/app/design/step-2/page.tsx is initialized to 1 and either not incrementing after room selection or is intentionally set to show anchor question progress (1 of 3 anchor questions within step 2). Need to verify intent.
